title: PATH is tabling at MAPS Psychedelic Science 2027
summary: Psychedelic Science 2027 is expected to bring together 8,000+ researchers, clinicians, policymakers, advocates, and cultural leaders around this year’s theme, “Bridging Promise & Practice”: how the field moves from possibility to on-the-ground reality through training, policy, infrastructure, and human relationships. PATH will have a table representing the heartland’s psychedelic community. Stop by to meet the groups in Oklahoma, Missouri, Kansas, and Arkansas, and find out how to get involved closer to home.

title: Kansas City Psychedelic Conference
summary: The inaugural Kansas City Psychedelic Conference, organized by the Psychedelic Society of Kansas City, at The Tree Room in downtown KC.

title: Psychedelic Freedom Conference 2026 — Springfield, MO
